written: 2026-11-21, before triage.py was run on any of these packages
selection_rule: Public GitHub repositories found by searching for 'replication package/files' that are the authors' own package for a named journal article, mixed across Stata, MATLAB, R and Python/Julia. Third-party re-replications were excluded. Pinned at their HEAD commit on the day of selection.
options_reason: Economics data desks normally hold Stata and often MATLAB licences; the verdict without them is trivially blocked.
rule: Each package is triaged once with this exact triage.py. Its verdict is then compared with a hand reading of the package's README, and every disagreement is recorded in results/heldout_review.md. triage.py is not changed in this pull request in response to these packages.
